output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.net_revenue), 0), 2) AS revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.country IN ('Germany', 'DE')
  AND o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-10-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: This sums net revenue for orders flagged as revenue (is_revenue), placed from 1 October to 31 December 2025 by customers whose country is Germany. It assumes Q4 means the calendar quarter by order date, and that shipping fees are not part of revenue. I didn't have the stored country values, so the filter accepts both "Germany" and "DE".
